items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic Face New Oversight as New York’s AI Safety Law Takes Effect
items.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic are now subject to new oversight as New York's AI safety law officially comes into effect, increasing regulatory pressure on leading AI companies.

items.title: Google Cloud Launches Gemini for Healthcare
items.summary: Google Cloud has launched Gemini for healthcare, offering specialized AI capabilities to transform medical operations and patient care.

items.title: Gemini Intelligence: New Features, On More Devices
items.summary: Google is rolling out new Gemini Intelligence features across more devices, enhancing its AI capabilities for a broader user base.

items.title: Adobe’s Creative and Productivity Tools Integrate with Google Apps
items.summary: Google and Adobe are deepening their partnership to integrate Adobe's creative and productivity tools more closely with Google's everyday applications.

items.title: OpenAI Acquires Odessia, Travel Startup Created by Sonder Founder
items.summary: OpenAI has acquired Odessia, a travel startup founded by the creator of Sonder, signaling its expansion into new application domains.

items.title: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
items.summary: Researchers are developing methods for learning diverse tactile representations to enable more general and dexterous manipulation capabilities in robots.

items.title: All 7 Anthropic Founders to Cash Out $250M Each in IPO
items.summary: All seven founders of Anthropic are set to cash out approximately $250 million each following the company's initial public offering.

items.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
items.summary: A new metacognitive AI architecture, Sage-Taiyi, is proposed to enhance and accelerate the process of scientific discovery.

items.title: Detecting Flaky Tests and Finding Their Root Causes with Strands Agents and Gemini
items.summary: This article explores how Strands Agents and Gemini can be utilized to effectively detect and diagnose the root causes of flaky tests in software development.

items.title: Auditable Human-Agent Teams for Autonomous X-ray Experimentation
items.summary: Researchers are developing auditable human-agent teams to enable autonomous X-ray experimentation, enhancing transparency and reliability in scientific processes.

items.title: EarthRecord: Multimodal Agents for Land Change Analysis Over Four Decades of Satellite Imagery
items.summary: EarthRecord introduces multimodal agents that analyze four decades of satellite imagery to track and understand land change from pixels to comprehensive insights.

items.title: Gilbert + Tobin Rethinks the Business of Law with AI
items.summary: Law firm Gilbert + Tobin is leveraging AI to innovate and rethink its business operations, demonstrating AI's growing impact in the legal sector.

items.title: Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
items.summary: Reframe proposes a novel multi-teacher on-policy distillation method aligned with observations to improve agentic visual reasoning capabilities.

items.title: Building Fine-Grained Version Control for Agents with Rust and Durable Objects
items.summary: This article details the creation of a fine-grained version control system for AI agents, utilizing Rust and Cloudflare's Durable Objects for robust state management.

items.title: ChatGPT Plus for Veterans and Servicemembers
items.summary: OpenAI is offering ChatGPT Plus subscriptions to veterans and servicemembers, expanding access to its advanced AI capabilities for this community.
